notes.title: 1.2.2.1 - Small fixes
notes.content:
The following are now fixed:
 - New cave palette and block style are no longer given for free. This was an accident, but all those who gained them will still get to keep them! Consider it a gift :)
- Can no longer mash the unpause key to spawn multiple countdown timers
- Countdown timer will now shift upwards if the head of the snake is underneath, improving visibility

notes.title: v1.2.2 - The Purge
notes.content:
[b]NEW![/b]
Name changing! You are now able to change your name. Your highscore and position in the high score tables are preserved, and your pin will not change.

Due to multiple reports of offensive or broken usernames, restrictions have now been applied to all SnOut usernames.
Previously, anything was allowed as long as it was 7 characters or less.
Now, this has been changed to the following:
 - 7 characters or less
 - Only Latin alphabet and numbers (no symbols, punctuation, or foreign letters accepted)
 - Content filter to block the most potentially offensive names.

If you have a name containing illegal characters or potentially offensive content, you will be asked to change it on your next login.
Any issues with:
 - Changing your name
 - Your current name not being offensive and wanting to keep it
 - An offensive name you see that has slipped through the filter and/or is not listed as offensive but you think it should be
Please contact via email (aarjvark@gmail.com), Twitter (@Aarjvark), or join the Discord (Button in top-right of game screen).

For accounts with seriously offensive names:
 - Low scoring (Less than 5 points) accounts have already been deleted.
 - Any other accounts will have until Thursday, 27th of May at 12pm UTC to change their name, after which they will be deleted.


[b]OTHER ADDITIONS![/b]
New Cave-themed Palette and Block Style
Staggered volume options for Music and SFX (OFF/LOW/MID/MAX compared to previous OFF/ON)
Short countdown timer when unpausing the game
Added some particles when the ball hits the wall, for extra ~juice~

Many thanks for playing!
